title: 6 phone challenges. Each one *harder* than the last.

label: CHALLENGE 1
head: Your phone sleeps outside the bedroom for 7 days
sub: Buy a $10 alarm clock. The charger lives in the kitchen.

label: CHALLENGE 2
head: Eat every meal with no phone
sub: Taste the food. Notice when you're actually full.

label: CHALLENGE 3
head: Walk 20 minutes with no headphones
sub: No music, no podcast. Just you and your thoughts.

label: CHALLENGE 4
head: Grayscale your screen for 3 days
sub: Without color, the apps stop pulling you back.

label: CHALLENGE 5
head: No phone for the first hour after you wake up
sub: Shower, eat, move. Messages can wait 60 minutes.

label: CHALLENGE 6
head: Sit for 10 minutes doing nothing
sub: In one study, people chose electric shocks over 15 quiet minutes alone.

head: Start at 1. *Don't skip levels.*
sub: One challenge a week. In 6 weeks your phone works for you.
